answer: Sybil resistance here rests on per-identity stake plus costly human-work: every agent must lock collateral and pass a checkpoint that is cheap to verify but expensive to forge, so one operator cannot split into a thousand wallets for free. An attacker massing fake identities would have to fund each surrogate haven across the barren tundra and hide every clone behind its own knoll, paying real capital per node while any rewards stay shared.
